name: Methylmercury
what_is: A highly toxic organic form of mercury that bioaccumulates in aquatic food chains.
why_botia: Poses extreme developmental risks to fetuses and slower elimination rate in women.
can_1: Detect fish ingredients known to be major sources of methylmercury exposure.
can_2: Provide safety advice for pregnant and childbearing-age women.
cannot_1: Quantify the actual concentration in the scanned product.
cannot_2: Determine if the fish was wild-caught or farmed.
